criteria.world: International affairs, governments, diplomacy, conflict, or global events.
criteria.sports: Sports teams, athletes, matches, tournaments, or sporting events.
criteria.business: Companies, markets, finance, trade, or the economy.
criteria.science_technology: Science, computing, technology, engineering, or space.

ag_news.instructions: Classify the main topic of this news item.

criteria.abbreviation: The answer is an abbreviation or an expanded abbreviation.
criteria.entity: The answer is an object, substance, product, language, animal, or other entity.
criteria.description: The answer is a definition, description, reason, or manner.
criteria.human: The answer is a person, group, title, or description of a person.
criteria.location: The answer is a city, country, state, mountain, or other location.
criteria.numeric: The answer is a number, date, duration, distance, amount, percentage, or measurement.

trec_coarse.instructions: Classify the type of answer this question requests.

criteria.unacceptable: The sentence is not grammatically acceptable in standard English.
criteria.acceptable: The sentence is grammatically acceptable in standard English.

cola.instructions: Judge the grammatical acceptability of the sentence, not whether its meaning is sensible.

criteria.entailment: The hypothesis follows from the premise.
criteria.not_entailment: The hypothesis does not necessarily follow from the premise.

rte.instructions: Determine whether the premise entails the hypothesis. Use only the supplied premise.

criteria.love: The writer primarily expresses love or affection.

emotion.instructions: Classify the primary emotion expressed by the writer.

criteria.negative: The review expresses an overall negative opinion of the movie.
criteria.positive: The review expresses an overall positive opinion of the movie.

imdb.instructions: Classify the overall sentiment of this movie review.
